trial_court: Family Court, Kottarakkara (O.P.(HMA) No.349 of 2015); Family Court, Vadakara (O.P.150 of 2016)
facts_of_case: The parties are the wife and husband who filed for divorce and maintenance. The wife is seeking dissolution of marriage due to strained relationship. The husband is seeking return of property. The case came to appeal as the wife wants all cases tried jointly in one court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish sufficient reasons for such transfer.
legal_principles.held: Though, notice had been properly served to the respondent, he has not chosen to enter appearance in this transfer petition.
cited_cases: Deepthi vs Sajeesh, (2016) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A party's convenience or hardship is not a sufficient reason to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: It is not disputed that O.P.(HMA) No.349 of 2015 before the Family Court, Kottarakkara under section 13(i-a) and (i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act read with section 7(1) of the Family Court Act for dissolution of marriage between the petitioner and the respondent.
cited_cases: Deepthi vs Sajeesh, (2016) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: The Family Court, Kottarakkara will try both O.P.(HMA) No.349 of 2015 and O.P.150 of 2016.
